messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: release 'v1.43.0' blocked — artifact upload checksum mismatch on staging. 1/3 mirrors reported digest != expected. integration-tests flaky on gpu-pool. Auto-promo paused.
Priya: what's failing in integration? unit tests green, only staging e2e failing?
qa-bot: 3 failing tests: LoginFlow.test_oauth_timeout, ImageProcessing.test_gpu_inference_retry, Upload.test_checksum_mismatch (see /ci/3987)
Dan: upload logs show multipart upload aborted mid-chunk, remote returned 0 bytes for part 4. Looks like transient S3 5xx during PUT_PART.
Nikhil: If a part zeroes, checksum will fail — we should reupload the artifact with --multipart-chunk-size 10M and verify sha256 after upload.
Priya: Change window ends in 25m. Two options: force reupload+rerun CI (takes ~18m) or pin last-known-good and promote. Which do we want?
ReleaseManager: prefer reupload first since this is a candidate release. If reupload fails twice, fallback to pin. Any objections?
Dan: +1 reupload, but add a preflight: `aws s3 cp build.tar.gz s3://ci-artifacts/sha256:$(sha256sum build.tar.gz)` then `curl -I` to ensure ETag present.
ops-bot: Created ticket CLOUD-11234 for intermittent S3 5xxs in eu-west-1. Noted incident for release-blocker.
deploybot: Note: auto-promote remains BLOCKED until artifact integrity verified for all mirrors. Manual promote allowed with `--force-manual` flag and approval by ReleaseManager.
Priya: I'll kick off a reupload + ci rerun now (attempt 1). Command: `./scripts/ci/publish-artifact --upload --verify && ./scripts/ci/start-pipeline 3987`
qa-bot: Pipeline started by Priya. Stage: staging-e2e (gpu-pool). ETA ~12m.
Nikhil: also add a checksum guard in deploy pipeline so promote fails explicitly if sha mismatch — prevents silent rollouts. I'll raise a quick PR.
Dan: Log excerpt from the failed upload:
```
ERROR: PUT_PART failed status=503 part=4 size=5242880
WARNING: wrote 0 bytes for part 4
expected_sha256=fa3b2c... got=000000...
```
Priya: Attempt 1 passed upload verification locally but CI still failing on gpu inference test. Rerunning ephemeral runner.
qa-bot: staging-e2e retry started.
ReleaseManager: timeline check: if retry doesn't green in 12m, we pin last-stable (v1.42.3) and promote to meet SLAs. Approving manual promote contingency.
Dan: If we pin, please note in release notes: "Promoted v1.42.3 due to artifact upload failures for v1.43.0; follow-up: retry logic + multipart robustness."
Priya: Attempt 2 reupload now with larger chunk size. Will monitor checksums across mirrors.
ops-bot: Mirror health: mirror-a OK, mirror-b delayed, mirror-c reporting ETag mismatch.
deploybot: Manual promote allowed by ReleaseManager token: `approve_manual_promote=ReleaseManager:6135801234` — but auto-promo stays paused.
qa-bot: Attempt 2 CI green on staging-e2e (all tests passed). Artifact checksums match across mirrors.
ReleaseManager: Good — proceed with promote of v1.43.0. But keep deploy throttled for 10m and monitor. Create follow-up to harden multipart handling.
Priya: Promoting now. deploybot: rolling canary at 5% for 10m.
deploybot: Canary ok. Scaling to 50%...
Dan: adding postmortem task to backlog: INVEST-789 multipart retry/backoff and CI checksum guard.
ReleaseManager: Closing hold for change window. Thanks everyone. Note: if mirrors regress, we revert to the pin plan."
